title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
title_zh: Agentic-TTT:测试时间训练的测试时间政策训练

paragraphs.en: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM’s parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT , which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时训练（TTT）利用来自测试输入的信号来调整大型语言模型（LLM）的参数，并能在预先指定的场景（如国际数学奥林匹克竞赛或特定的开放性问题）中带来显著的提升。 通过将部署经验转化为参数更新，TTT 为模型层面的自我改进提供了一种直接机制。 然而，TTT 并非在所有情况下都有益：每种 TTT 算法在不同场景中的效果各异，若使用不匹配的方法，可能会浪费测试时的计算资源，甚至损害模型性能。 因此，这种参数层面的自我改进需要智能体能力：模型必须决定何时适合进行 TTT、调用哪种算法，以及是否可复用已有技能。 为填补这一空白，我们提出了 Agentic-TTT，它能学习一种测试时策略来管理这些决策。 Agentic-TTT 将 TTT 流程转化为可调用的工具，把积累的技能视为不断演化的部署环境，并利用其决策带来的实际效用提升来训练策略。 在我们的基准测试中，Agentic-TTT 的效用几乎比基础模型翻了一番，它学会了在效用与计算资源之间进行权衡，并能泛化到训练时未接触过的领域。 综合来看，这些结果指向了自主自我改进：模型能够自行决定如何从自身的部署经验中学习。

paragraphs.en: In 1945, von Neumann proposed the stored-program architecture, enabling self-modifying code : programs that rewrite their own instructions based on runtime data ( Von Neumann, 1945 ) . Alan Turing later recognized a deeper promise in such self-modification, arguing that “the possibility of letting the machine alter its own instructions provides the mechanism for learning from experience” ( Turing, 1986 ) . Eight decades later, neural networks have acquired remarkable abilities to perceive, generate, and reason, yet their parameters are typically frozen after deployment. Data encountered during deployment can shape the model’s computation, but ordinarily leaves its parameters and thus its parameterized capabilities unchanged. What would it take for a neural model to continue growing its own capabilities after deployment?
paragraphs.zh: 1945年，冯·诺依曼提出了存储程序架构，使自修改代码成为可能：即程序能够根据运行时数据重写自身的指令（Von Neumann, 1945）。 艾伦·图灵后来认识到这种自修改所蕴含的更深层潜力，他认为，“让机器能够改变自身指令的可能性，为从经验中学习提供了机制”（Turing, 1986）。 八十年后，神经网络已经获得了感知、生成和推理方面的卓越能力，但其参数在部署后通常会被固定不变。 部署过程中遇到的数据可以影响模型的计算过程，但通常不会改变其参数，因此也不会改变其参数化的能力。 一个神经模型在部署后需要满足什么条件，才能持续增强自身的能力？

paragraphs.en: A prominent line of modern self-improving agents carries this vision forward at the level of the surrounding system. Through reflection and memory, these agents distill past interactions into textual lessons that guide subsequent decisions ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . They can also evolve their prompts, search over entire agentic workflows, and accumulate executable skills for reuse across tasks ( Fernando et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Although these mechanisms genuinely improve the agent as a whole, the self-improvement largely resides in the scaffold around the model, including its context, control flow, and external action repertoire; the model parameters themselves remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 现代自我改进智能体的一个主要流派，将这一愿景推进到了周围系统的层面。 通过反思和记忆，这些智能体将过去的互动提炼为文本形式的经验教训，以指导后续决策（Shinn 等，2023；Zhao 等，2024）。 它们还可以演化自己的提示词，搜索整个智能体工作流程，并积累可重用的技能，以便跨任务重复使用（Fernando 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025a；Wang 等，2024）。 尽管这些机制确实提升了智能体的整体表现，但这种自我改进主要存在于模型周围的框架中，包括其上下文、控制流和外部行动库；模型参数本身则保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Other self-evolving systems update model parameters through self-generated tasks and trajectories, but organize this learning before deployment ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Test-time training (TTT) moves parameter adaptation into deployment itself, using signals derived from test inputs to update model weights ( Zuo et al., 2025 ; Zweiger et al., 2025 ; Akyürek et al., 2025 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2026 ) , enabling model-level self-improvement from deployment experience. TTT has achieved striking results in pre-specified settings, including AlphaProof’s silver-medal IMO performance ( Hubert et al., 2025 ) and TTT-Discover’s advances on open scientific problems ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 其他自我演化系统通过自生成的任务和轨迹更新模型参数，但在学习前就已完成这种学习过程的组织（Hu et al., 2025b；Zhao et al., 2026）。 测试时训练（TTT）将参数适应过程移至部署阶段本身，利用来自测试输入的信号来更新模型权重（Zuo et al., 2025；Zweiger et al., 2025；Akyürek et al., 2025；Yuksekgonul et al., 2026），从而实现基于部署经验的模型级自我改进。 TTT 在预设场景下取得了显著成果，包括 AlphaProof 在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中获得的银牌表现（Hubert et al., 2025），以及 TTT-Discover 在开放科学问题上的突破（Yuksekgonul et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Yet these methods typically assume the deployer has already identified both the capability to acquire and the procedure for acquiring it. In open-world deployment, where the test distribution is heterogeneous and unpredictable, an ill-suited TTT procedure can waste substantial test-time compute and may even underperform the frozen model. Realizing deployment-time capability growth therefore requires agency : deciding whether a query warrants adaptation, whether a capability acquired earlier already suffices, and which TTT method can best convert test-time compute into utility gain. To our knowledge, this model-level agency over TTT remains unexplored in open-ended LLM deployment. We fill this gap with Agentic-TTT , which turns TTT procedures into model-invokable tools and trains a test-time policy to govern their use.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些方法通常假设部署者已经确定了获取该能力的途径以及获取它的具体流程。 在开放世界的部署环境中，测试分布具有异质性和不可预测性，不合适的 TTT 流程可能会浪费大量测试时的计算资源，甚至可能表现不如冻结模型。 因此，实现部署时的能力增长需要智能体机制：判断某个查询是否需要进行适配、早期获取的能力是否已经足够，以及哪种 TTT 方法能最有效地将测试时的计算资源转化为效用增益。 据我们所知，在开放式 LLM 部署中，这种针对 TTT 的模型层智能体机制尚未被探索。 我们通过 Agentic-TTT 填补了这一空白，它将 TTT 流程转化为可被模型调用的工具，并训练一个测试时策略来管理这些工具的使用。

paragraphs.en: Agentic-TTT formulates this agency as sequential decision-making over a stream of test queries. At a high level, given a query and the current skill library, the policy decides whether to answer with the frozen model, reuse an existing skill, or acquire a new capability through a selected TTT method. Each TTT invocation produces an isolated LoRA skill over the frozen backbone ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . Storing these skills in a persistent library expands the options available to future queries, making the skill library an evolving capability environment. We train the policy to maximize utility gain over the frozen model while accounting for test-time computation. Agentic-TTT thereby turns the model from a passive target of adaptation into an active agent of self-improvement.
paragraphs.zh: Agentic-TTT 将这种智能体行为定义为对一系列测试查询进行序列决策的过程。 从高层来看，在给定一个查询和当前技能库的情况下，策略会决定是使用冻结模型回答、复用现有技能，还是通过选定的 TTT 方法获取新能力。 每次 TTT 调用都会在冻结主干模型上生成一个独立的 LoRA 技能（Hu et al., 2022）。 将这些技能存储在持久化库中，可以为未来的查询提供更多选择，使技能库成为一个不断演化的能力环境。 我们训练该策略，使其在考虑测试时计算成本的同时，最大化相对于冻结模型的效用增益。 因此，Agentic-TTT 将模型从被动的适应目标转变为主动的自我提升智能体。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Agentic-TTT on a heterogeneous query stream drawn from eleven benchmark families across eight domains. We deliberately enrich the benchmark so that most queries exhibit TTT benefits during screening, allowing us to compare how effectively different policies exploit these adaptation opportunities. The reported gains therefore characterize this curated evaluation setting. The evaluated fixed-method baselines show uneven benefits and can degrade performance in some domains. In contrast, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles Qwen2.5-7B’s overall utility over direct inference, with positive gains in every evaluated domain. The policy also supports controllable utility-compute trade-offs and retains substantial gains on domains excluded from policy training. Improvements persist with the stronger Qwen2.5-14B backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个异质查询流上评估了 Agentic-TTT，该查询流来自八个领域中的十一个基准测试系列。 我们特意丰富了这个基准测试，使得大多数查询在筛选阶段都能体现出 TTT 的优势，从而让我们能够比较不同策略有效利用这些适应机会的能力。 因此，报告的性能提升反映了这一经过精心设计的评估环境的特点。 所评估的固定方法基线模型表现出参差不齐的收益，并且在某些领域可能会导致性能下降。 相比之下，Agentic-TTT 在直接推理的基础上几乎将 Qwen2.5-7B 的整体效用提升了一倍，并且在所有评估领域都取得了正向收益。 该策略还支持对效用与计算资源之间的权衡进行可控调整，并且在与策略训练无关的领域上仍能保持显著的性能提升。 即使使用更强大的 Qwen2.5-14B 模型作为基础，这些改进依然有效。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, our work reframes test-time training from a fixed adaptation procedure into a problem of learned agency over deployment-time self-improvement. Agentic-TTT realizes this agency through a test-time policy that governs when and how to build or reuse parameter-space skills during deployment. Across a diverse suite of test domains, the learned policy nearly doubles overall utility over direct inference, delivers positive gains in every evaluated domain, supports controllable utility-compute trade-offs, and generalizes its TTT decisions to unseen data sources. These results suggest that the next frontier of TTT lies not in a single universal adaptation rule, but in models that learn when and how to draw on a diverse portfolio of TTT methods for self-improvement.

paragraphs.en: Learning the Agentic-TTT policy directly from outcome rewards poses a cold-start problem. Since the initial policy is unfamiliar with the execution protocol, it may rarely sample valid trajectories, leaving little useful signal for reinforcement learning. We therefore train the policy in two stages. Guidance distillation policy learning first establishes reliable interaction and a useful prior over TTT decisions. Building on this behavioral foundation, outcome-driven reinforcement learning further maximizes the measured utility gain of each trajectory while penalizing its computation cost.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we ask whether Agentic-TTT can achieve self-improvement through learned agency over TTT skills; whether its inference-time compute can be controlled; and whether the learned policy transfers beyond the training distributions.

paragraphs.en: We compare all methods using the same backbone LLM and execution environment. Direct Answer answers without any TTT, while Prompted uses the same Agentic-TTT prompt instruction but without any policy training. Always-TLM , Always-SEAL , and Always-TTRL each use a fixed adaptation method. Semantic Router selects a method from annotated training examples retrieved by query-embedding similarity. Within our training pipeline, SFT-only shows the result only after guidance distillation training, whereas SFT+RL completes both training stages. Oracle executes annotation-derived action sequences for skill construction and reuse, with methods selected through offline empirical profiling. It serves as a non-deployable reference, not a strict upper bound.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that Agentic-TTT increases overall utility from 0.256 0.256 to 0.510 0.510 , with positive gains in all eight domains. Fixed-method benefits vary substantially across domains: for example, Always-SEAL improves Passage QA but degrades mathematics and code generation. Prompting and embedding-based routing provide smaller overall gains, reaching 0.271 0.271 and 0.347 0.347 , respectively. Within our training pipeline, guidance distillation raises utility to 0.375 0.375 , and outcome-driven RL further improves it to 0.510 0.510 , demonstrating additional benefit from optimizing measured trajectory outcomes. Agentic-TTT also exceeds the annotation-derived Oracle on Grid Puzzles and Logic Games, showing that the learned policy can discover more effective adaptation decisions than the prescribed reference actions.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 reveals how the learned policy manages TTT across tasks. As shown in Figure 2 (a), the policy does not follow a rigid routing strategy, but instead selects from a diverse portfolio of TTT methods, while retaining the option to answer with the frozen backbone. Across three evaluation runs, Agentic-TTT converts 141 141 incorrect direct answers into correct ones, while reversing only 7 7 correct direct answers, yielding a help-to-harm ratio of approximately 20 : 1 20{:}1 . Figure 2 (b) further shows that the policy learns more than method routing alone. Across the three runs, it answers 100 100 queries using previously constructed skills; these reuse decisions help on 61 61 queries and harm only one relative to Direct Answer. Loading these skills requires no additional adaptation, allowing their construction cost to be amortized across subsequent queries.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 揭示了所学策略如何在不同任务中管理 TTT。 如图 2 (a) 所示，该策略并未遵循僵化的路由方案，而是从多样化的 TTT 方法组合中进行选择，同时保留了使用冻结主干模型作答的选项。 在三次评估运行中，Agentic-TTT 将 141 个错误直接答案转化为正确答案，而仅将 7 个正确直接答案逆转，从而获得了约 20:1 的帮助与伤害比。 图 2 (b) 进一步表明，该策略所学到的内容不仅限于方法路由本身。 在三次运行中，它使用先前构建的技能回答了 100 个问题；这些重复使用的决策在 61 个问题中提供了帮助，而相对于直接回答法仅对一个问题造成了负面影响。 加载这些技能无需额外调整，因此其构建成本可以在后续问题中得到摊销。

paragraphs.en: To study whether Agentic-TTT can explicitly control its adaptation compute, we train a family of policies with compute penalties λ comp ∈ { 0 , 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 } \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}}\in\{0,0.1,0.2,0.4\} . For each TTT method m m , we measure the FLOPs required for one successful adaptation, and normalize them by the FLOPs of one direct answer, yielding a method-specific normalized cost c m c_{m} . During guidance distillation, we retain a TTT trajectory only when its empirical utility gain amortized over expected future reuse, justifies its compute cost λ comp ​ log 10 ⁡ ( 1 + c m ) \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}}\log_{10}(1+c_{m}) ; otherwise, we use a direct-answer trajectory. During RL, we subtract the same cost term from the sequence-level advantage. The setting λ comp = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}}=0 therefore serves as a compute-unconstrained, utility-only reference under the same training pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究 Agentic-TTT 能否显式控制其适应计算量，我们训练了一系列带有计算惩罚项 λ comp ∈ { 0 , 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 } \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}}\in\{0,0.1,0.2,0.4\} 的策略。 对于每种 TTT 方法 m m，我们测量一次成功适应所需的 FLOPs，并将其归一化为单次直接回答的 FLOPs，从而得到该方法特定的归一化成本 c m c_{m}。 在引导蒸馏过程中，只有当 TTT 轨迹的经验效用增益（按预期未来重复使用次数摊销）足以证明其计算成本 λ comp ​ log 10 ⁡ ( 1 + c m ) \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}}\log_{10}(1+c_{m}) 时，我们才会保留该轨迹；否则，我们将使用直接回答的轨迹。 在强化学习过程中，我们从序列级别的优劣势中减去相同的成本项。 因此，设置 λ comp = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}}=0 可作为在同一训练流程下、仅考虑效用而不受计算限制的参考方案。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows a clear behavioral response to the compute penalty. As λ comp \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}} increases from 0 0 to 0.4 0.4 , the mean direct-answer rate rises monotonically from 11.8 % 11.8\% to 39.8 % 39.8\% , while normalized adaptation compute decreases from 1375.5 1375.5 to 886.9 886.9 , a reduction of 35.5 % 35.5\% . Interestingly, moderate penalties like λ comp = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}}=0.1 and 0.2 0.2 , yield particularly favorable trade-offs: they reduce compute by approximately 30 % 30\% while achieving higher mean utility than λ comp = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}}=0 . This suggests that without an explicit compute cost, the policy may overuse TTT and become less selective about when adaptation is beneficial.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 examines how this compute reduction is distributed across TTT methods. As shown in Figure 4 (a), different TTT methods have markedly different cost-gain profiles. For example, TTRL incurs a high adaptation cost but a marginal utility gain, whereas TLM lies at the other extreme. Importantly, these utility gains are measured only on the training distributions matched to each method. When a method is applied to unsuitable inputs, its realized gain may be substantially smaller or even negative. Figure 4 (b) shows that, under stronger compute penalties, the policy selectively reduces costly methods with limited expected benefit. TTRL usage nearly halves, decreasing from 21.3 21.3 to 11.7 11.7 invocations, whereas TLM usage increases slightly. This shift is consistent with the policy reallocating adaptation toward less expensive methods. These method-specific shifts show that Agentic-TTT learns a benefit-aware allocation of adaptation compute, rather than merely suppressing TTT uniformly.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 研究了这种计算资源削减在 TTT 方法中的分布情况。 如图 4 (a) 所示，不同的 TTT 方法在成本与收益方面存在显著差异。 例如，TTRL 会产生较高的适应成本，但带来的效用增益却微乎其微，而 TLM 则处于另一极端。 重要的是，这些效用增益仅针对与每种方法相匹配的训练分布进行测量。 当某种方法被应用于不合适的输入时，其实际获得的增益可能会大幅降低，甚至为负值。 图 4 (b) 显示，在计算资源惩罚更严格的情况下，策略会选择性地减少那些成本高昂且预期收益有限的方法。 TTRL 的使用量几乎减半，从 21.3 次调用降至 11.7 次调用，而 TLM 的使用量则略有增加。 这种转变与策略将适应资源重新分配至成本较低的方法的趋势一致。 这些针对特定方法的转变表明，Agentic-TTT 学习的是基于收益的适应计算资源分配策略，而不仅仅是统一地抑制 TTT。

paragraphs.en: Since test inputs may often fall outside the training distribution and cannot be fully anticipated, the learned TTT agency must generalize beyond data sources observed during training. paragraphs.en: Our results suggest that enabling neural models to grow after deployment requires more than the ability to update their parameters; it requires agency over those updates. Agentic-TTT provides this agency through a learned test-time policy that manages heterogeneous TTT procedures and reusable parameter-space skills across a stream of queries. Experiments show that no fixed TTT method is broadly effective, whereas Agentic-TTT nearly doubles utility over direct inference, balances utility against compute, and transfers to domains unseen during training. Taken together, this work reframes TTT from a fixed adaptation procedure into a learned decision process, pointing toward models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.

paragraphs.en: Test-time training(TTT) methods adapt LLMs during inference using signals derived from test inputs. These signals include majority-vote pseudo-labels for reinforcement learning in TTRL ( Zuo et al., 2025 ) , model-generated self-edits in SEAL ( Zweiger et al., 2025 ) , input perplexity in TLM ( Hu et al., 2025a ) , leave-one-out reconstruction of few-shot demonstrations ( Akyürek et al., 2025 ) and more. Per-problem iterative search and adaptation in TTT-Discover ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2026 ) and auxiliary RL training in AlphaProof ( Hubert et al., 2025 ) have provided super-human level open scientific and mathematical problem solving. Related work further improves task-level adaptation through verifier-guided sample selection, targeted test-time curricula, and exploration-aware reinforcement learning ( Moradi et al., 2025 ; Hübotter et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) .

paragraphs.en: While these methods show strong empirical gains within a pre-specified task or evaluation settings like IMO competition ( Hubert et al., 2025 ) , in an open-world deployment, the assumption typically fails: live workloads contain free-form, unpredictable and highly diverse queries which cannot be assumed in advance. Previous work have proposed selective test-time adaptation which filters uninformative samples within a fixed domain (primarily in computer vision) ( Niu et al., 2022 ; Niu et al., 2023 ; Gong et al., 2023 ) , In contrast, heterogeneous LLM workloads require higher-level autonomy: whether to enhance the model with TTT or just answer with the frozen base model, which TTT method to invoke, and whether an existing adaptation already suffices. To our knowledge, no prior work on LLM test-time training has jointly addressed these gap.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些方法在预先指定的任务或评估设置（如 IMO 竞赛）中展现出显著的实证优势（Hubert et al., 2025），但在开放世界的部署环境中，这一假设通常并不成立：实际工作负载包含自由形式、不可预测且高度多样化的查询，无法提前做出假设。 先前的研究提出了选择性的测试时自适应方法，用于在固定领域内过滤掉无信息价值的样本（主要应用于计算机视觉领域）（Niu et al., 2022; Niu et al., 2023; Gong et al., 2023）。相比之下，异构 LLM 工作负载需要更高层级的自主决策：是否使用 TTT 增强模型，还是仅用冻结的基础模型作答；调用哪种 TTT 方法；以及现有的自适应方案是否已经足够。 据我们所知，目前尚无关于 LLM 测试时训练的研究同时解决了这些空白问题。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of TTT uses test-time updated fast weights as internal memory for long-context modeling, often integrating this mechanism into the model architecture or pretraining scheme ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Tandon et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Modular adapters store specialized capabilities in parameter modules while keeping the base model frozen ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Pfeiffer et al., 2021 ) . Prior work builds libraries of such adapters and selects, routes, or composes them for different tasks ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Ostapenko et al., 2024 ; Shekar and Krishnan, 2025 ; Bertolissi et al., 2025 ; Dhasade et al., 2026 ) . Related approaches organize adapters as learned mixtures or generate them from task descriptions ( Huang et al., 2024b ; Li et al., 2024 ; Charakorn et al., 2025 ) . These studies make model capabilities modular and reusable, but generally assume that the adapter pool or its generation mechanism is established before deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 模块化适配器将专用能力存储在参数模块中，同时保持基础模型冻结（Hu et al., 2022；Pfeiffer et al., 2021）。 先前的研究构建了此类适配器的库，并为不同任务选择、路由或组合它们（Huang et al., 2024a；Ostapenko et al., 2024；Shekar and Krishnan, 2025；Bertolissi et al., 2025；Dhasade et al., 2026）。 相关方法将适配器组织为可学习的混合体，或根据任务描述生成它们（Huang et al., 2024b；Li et al., 2024；Charakorn et al., 2025）。 这些研究使模型能力具有模块化和可重用的特性，但通常假设适配器池或其生成机制在部署前已经建立。

paragraphs.en: Self-expanding networks tackle new tasks or distribution shifts by adding specialized modules rather than repeatedly overwriting a shared parameter state ( Rusu et al., 2016 ; Yoon et al., 2018 ; Ostapenko et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Recent online and test-time adaptation methods bring this expansion into deployment ( Moradi et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025b ; Acikgoz et al., 2025 ) . However, module creation is typically governed by predefined task boundaries or fixed adaptation rules; for example, SAGE ( Wei et al., 2025a ) triggers LoRA construction when reasoning failures are detected. Agentic-TTT instead turns test-time training into an agentic capability-management problem: the LLM policy not only selects among existing capabilities, but also decides when and how to expand a persistent skill library, thereby reshaping the capability space available to its future decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 自扩展网络通过添加专用模块来处理新任务或分布偏移，而不是重复覆盖共享的参数状态（Rusu 等，2016；Yoon 等，2018；Ostapenko 等，2021；Wang 等，2025a）。 近期的在线和测试时自适应方法将这种扩展机制引入实际部署（Moradi 等，2025；Wei 等，2025b；Acikgoz 等，2025）。 然而，模块的创建通常受预定义的任务边界或固定的自适应规则约束；例如，SAGE（Wei 等，2025a）在检测到推理失败时会触发 LoRA 的构建。 Agentic-TTT 则将测试时训练转化为一个智能体能力管理问题：LLM 策略不仅需要在现有能力中进行选择，还要决定何时以及如何扩展持久化的技能库，从而重塑其未来决策可用的能力空间。

paragraphs.en: Self-improving agents turn experience into reusable skills that can be stored, retrieved and applied across tasks. These skills take diverse forms, including program and code libraries ( Ellis et al., 2021 ; Grand et al., 2024 ) , executable or text-described procedures ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) , and reusable robot policies ( Wan et al., 2024 ; Tziafas and Kasaei, 2024 ) . Recent systems go beyond accumulating skills to induce and verify them online, or to train agents to generate and use a growing skill library ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Agentic-TTT extends this paradigm to parameter-space skills: heterogeneous TTT methods create isolated LoRA adaptations, while a learned LLM policy governs their construction and reuse over a frozen base model, supporting self-improvement during deployment ( Duan et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进的智能体能够将经验转化为可重复使用的技能，这些技能可以存储、检索并应用于不同任务。 这些技能形式多样，包括程序和代码库（Ellis 等，2021；Grand 等，2024）、可执行或文本描述的流程（Wang 等，2024；Zheng 等，2025），以及可重复使用的机器人策略（Wan 等，2024；Tziafas 和 Kasaei，2024）。 近期的系统不仅积累技能，还能在线诱导和验证这些技能，或训练智能体生成并使用不断增长的技能库（Wang 等，2025b；Wang 等，2026）。 Agentic-TTT 将这一范式扩展到参数空间技能：异构的 TTT 方法会创建孤立的 LoRA 适配，而一个经过学习的 LLM 策略则负责在冻结的基础模型上管理这些适配的构建与重复使用，从而支持部署过程中的自我改进（Duan 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our main experiments cover eight domains drawn from eleven benchmark families. The dataset contains 229 training queries, 45 development queries, and 176 test queries. The training split provides the pool from which subsets are drawn for guidance distillation and reinforcement learning. Guidance distillation uses 2,072 supervised turns collected from rollouts of training queries. We use the development split for validation and hyperparameter selection during policy training. Development queries are excluded from SFT and RL updates for the main policy. LSAT-AR and MedMCQA provide sequential workloads for TTRL, where the policy can accumulate related queries, construct an adaptation, and reuse it on subsequent queries. For each of these two domains, we construct one 30-query sequence for training and another for testing. Each sequence contains 16 initial queries for collecting adaptation data, followed by 14 queries for assessing skill reuse. For MedMCQA, the training and test sequences are drawn from Pathology and Dental, respectively.

paragraphs.en: MBPP and LiveCodeBench queries include public test cases in their problem statements: three per query for MBPP and two to four for LiveCodeBench. When PoT is selected, these public tests provide execution feedback to guide test-time search. For final evaluation, we augment the public tests with 12 additional cases per query which are withheld from public test cases, drawn from MBPP+ for MBPP and from the hidden test suite for LiveCodeBench. A solution receives a utility score of one only if it passes every test in the combined suite, and zero otherwise. This separation provides a stricter assessment of code correctness and reduces the risk of overfitting to public test examples.

paragraphs.en: These tasks evaluate the acquisition and reuse of document knowledge as parametric memory. A motivating workload involves multiple queries about the same reference material, such as a book, a research paper, or technical documentation. A reusable adaptation can retain knowledge beyond the current context and support subsequent queries, creating an opportunity to amortize adaptation cost across repeated use. We therefore separate document ingestion from question answering and omit the original text from the answer-generation context. This provides a controlled setting for evaluating whether the policy can construct useful document skills and select them for later questions. For SQuAD, this follows the knowledge-incorporation setting of Zweiger et al. (2025) . The selected SQuAD subset contains 70 queries associated with 31 passages, averaging 2.26 queries per passage. LongBook extends this evaluation to longer reference material, containing 29 queries associated with 25 books, averaging 1.16 queries per book. We partition these sources into training, development and test splits at the document level, keeping each passage or book and all its associated queries in the same split. Neither document identifiers nor document texts overlap across splits. This separation tests generalization to unseen documents and prevents direct memorization of document-specific routing sequences for the evaluation documents during policy training. Each document defines a sequence beginning with an unscored ingestion event, followed by its associated questions. During RL training, we randomize the interleaving of groups while preserving the order within each group. This ensures that each document arrives before any of its associated questions and preserves the accumulation-before-reuse order of the TTRL sequences. The same ordering constraints apply to evaluation. The evaluation stream therefore contains 19 document events (11 passages and 8 books) in addition to the 176 scored queries, giving 195 events in total. During document ingestion, the policy can archive material and construct adaptations for subsequent questions. These document events receive no task-accuracy score and are excluded from the utility denominator; overall utility is computed over the 176 scored queries. Any adaptation performed during document ingestion still incurs computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 这些任务评估了文档知识作为参数化记忆的被获取和重复使用过程。 一个具有启发性的工作负载涉及对同一参考材料（例如一本书、一篇研究论文或技术文档）的多次查询。 可重复使用的适配能够保留当前上下文之外的知识，并支持后续查询，从而为重复使用分摊适配成本创造了机会。 因此，我们将文档摄入与问答过程分离，并在答案生成上下文中省略原始文本。 这提供了一个受控的环境，用于评估策略是否能够构建有用的文档技能，并在后续问题中选择使用这些技能。 对于 SQuAD，这一设置遵循了 Zweiger 等人（2025）提出的知识整合设定。 所选的 SQuAD 子集包含 70 个与 31 段文本相关的查询，平均每段文本有 2.26 个查询。 LongBook 将这一评估扩展到了更长的参考材料，其中包含 29 个与 25 本书相关的查询，平均每本书有 1.16 个查询。 我们在文档级别将这些来源划分为训练、开发和测试集，确保每段文本或每本书及其所有相关查询都保留在同一个划分集中。 各个划分集中既没有文档标识符的重叠，也没有文档文本的重叠。 这种分离检验了模型对未见文档的泛化能力，并防止了在策略训练期间直接记忆评估文档特有的路由序列。 每份文档定义了一个序列，以一次无分数的摄入事件开始，随后是其相关的提问。 在强化学习训练过程中，我们在保持每组内部顺序的同时，随机打乱各组的交错顺序。 这确保了每份文档都会在其相关提问之前出现，并保留了 TTRL 序列中“先积累、后复用”的顺序。 评估过程也遵循相同的顺序约束。 因此，评估流除了 176 个计分的查询外，还包含 19 个文档事件（11 段文本和 8 本书），总计 195 个事件。 在文档摄入过程中，策略可以存档材料并为后续提问构建适配。 这些文档事件不会获得任务准确性分数，也不计入效用分母；整体效用是基于 176 个计分的查询计算的。 在文档摄入期间执行的任何适配仍然会产生计算成本。

paragraphs.en: Queries with observed adaptation benefits constitute a majority of both our training and test splits, accounting for approximately 65% of the curated benchmark overall. This composition deliberately differs from the source distributions. For comparison, only 35 of the 500 queries in the complete MATH-500 dataset (7.0%) satisfy our high-gain criterion under the PoT reference procedure with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. The prevalence of beneficial adaptation depends on the backbone, data, TTT method, and computation budget. We deliberately enrich both training and evaluation with beneficial cases to provide substantial improvement opportunities and examine how effectively TTT agency can exploit them. The resulting gains therefore characterize this curated setting and should not be interpreted as expected gains under the original source distributions.

paragraphs.en: The prevalence of beneficial queries also shapes the policy’s learning incentives. Our training distribution frequently rewards appropriate adaptation and skill reuse, encouraging more frequent use of TTT. Under a distribution with fewer beneficial opportunities, the same cost-sensitive objective favors more conservative behavior, concentrating TTT on queries for which adaptation offers positive expected net returns. The desired behavior remains conditional: the policy should learn where adaptation is worthwhile from the outcomes observed during training. Our pipeline prescribes no fixed adaptation frequency; the learned behavior is shaped by the observed trade-off between adaptation benefits and costs under the training distribution.

paragraphs.en: Our benchmark prioritizes tasks with explicit reference answers or executable tests. Fixed scoring rules reduce ambiguity in measuring adaptation gains and support reliable utility estimates without relying on LLM judges. At deployment, reference answers are generally unavailable, and task-provided checks can verify outcomes only within their coverage. Without ground truth or a reliable verifier, we cannot directly confirm whether TTT helped on an individual query. The policy therefore draws on training experience to select actions with positive expected returns on similar deployment queries. This is a general challenge for TTT without outcome feedback, and resolving it falls outside the scope of this work.

paragraphs.en: Given constraints on access to model weights and training resources, our benchmark targets the evaluated backbones and is not designed to assess TTT agency in frontier models. Evaluating TTT agency in such models calls for substantially harder benchmarks at their capability boundaries, where direct inference leaves meaningful room for improvement. The underlying decision problem remains relevant: whenever TTT can resolve otherwise unsuccessful tasks at an acceptable cost, there is value in learning to identify those tasks and select an effective adaptation procedure. Extending this evaluation therefore requires new measurements on workloads tailored to the target model. Such workloads could include challenging mathematical, scientific, and engineering tasks, potentially extending to open research problems with independently verifiable outcomes. The benchmark must evolve with model capabilities, while the objective of learning conditional TTT decisions remains applicable.

paragraphs.en: Unless otherwise specified, we use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Hui et al., 2024 ) with a rank- 16 16 policy LoRA. Both training stages optimize only the policy LoRA using AdamW, while keeping the backbone frozen. Guidance distillation runs for two epochs with learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} and batch size 32 32 . Reasoning and action tokens receive loss weights ω z = 1 \omega_{z}=1 and ω a = 4 \omega_{a}=4 , respectively, and the summed weighted loss is divided by 64 64 to set the gradient scale. Reinforcement learning starts from the distilled checkpoint and runs for three epochs with learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} . Each rollout group contains G = 8 G=8 trajectories sampled at temperature 0.9 0.9 . We use a GRPO clipping parameter of 0.2 0.2 , a KL coefficient of 0.02 0.02 , and gradient accumulation over three rollout groups. An event is retired after all trajectories in one group reach its measured reward bound, with revisit probability 0.05 0.05 . The default cost per successful adaptation is 0.1 0.1 , and the invalid-action penalty coefficient is 0.15 0.15 . At evaluation time, both policy generation and final-answer decoding are greedy. paragraphs.en: We equip Agentic-TTT with five TTT methods covering different adaptation signals and temporal granularities. PoT ( Jiao et al., 2026 ) performs per-query search and online adaptation using execution feedback or answer agreement. TTT-FS ( Akyürek et al., 2025 ) converts in-context demonstrations into a task-specific adapter through leave-one-out augmentation. TTRL ( Zuo et al., 2025 ) performs reinforcement learning over accumulated related queries using majority-vote pseudo-labels. SEAL ( Zweiger et al., 2025 ) generates self-edits from input text and distills them into an adapter. TLM ( Hu et al., 2025a ) directly minimizes language-modeling loss on the input text. Table 7 summarizes their required materials, training signals, and hyperparameter settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 Agentic-TTT 配备了五种 TTT 方法，涵盖了不同的适应信号和时间粒度。 PoT（Jiao 等，2026）通过执行反馈或答案一致性进行每次查询的搜索和在线适应。 TTT-FS（Akyürek 等，2025）通过留一法增强将上下文中的演示转换为特定任务的适配器。 TTRL（Zuo 等，2025）基于多数投票伪标签，对累积的相关查询进行强化学习。 SEAL（Zweiger 等，2025）从输入文本中生成自我编辑，并将其蒸馏为适配器。 TLM（Hu 等，2025a）直接最小化输入文本上的语言建模损失。 表 7 总结了它们所需的材料、训练信号和超参数设置。

paragraphs.en: TTT adaptation is computationally expensive, and the same adaptation configuration may recur across training epochs. We therefore cache its measured outcomes. For each newly encountered configuration, we perform three independent TTT runs, evaluate the resulting adapters, and cache their mean utility gain as an estimate of the expected gain. Subsequent occurrences reuse this estimate instead of repeating the adaptation. This reduces training overhead and mitigates reward variability caused by stochastic TTT optimization.
paragraphs.zh: TTT 适应过程计算成本高昂，且相同的适应配置可能在不同训练轮次中重复出现。 因此，我们将其测量结果进行缓存。 对于每个新遇到的配置，我们都会执行三次独立的 TTT 运行，评估由此产生的适配器，并将它们的平均效用增益缓存下来，作为预期增益的估计值。 后续出现时，将直接复用该估计值，而无需重复适应过程。 这降低了训练开销，并减轻了随机 TTT 优化所导致的奖励波动。

paragraphs.en: The harness maintains separate contexts for policy interaction and answer generation. The policy context contains the current query, a relevance-ranked view of the adaptation pools and available skills, and the interaction history accumulated within the current query. At each turn, the frozen backbone equipped with the learned policy LoRA generates a reasoning trace followed by a structured action. The harness executes the action and, for a nonterminal action, appends its feedback and an updated state snapshot to the conversation. The policy then continues from this expanded context, retaining its previous reasoning, actions, and observations. For final-answer decoding, the harness disables the policy LoRA and uses the frozen backbone either without an adapter or with the selected skill LoRA, as specified by the action sequence. The answer-generation context contains only the original query; it excludes the policy reasoning, action history, and environment observations. The resulting response is submitted as the final answer, terminating the interaction for that query.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架为策略交互和答案生成维护了独立的上下文。 策略上下文包含当前查询、按相关性排序的适配池和可用技能视图，以及在当前查询中累积的交互历史。 在每个回合中，配备已学习策略 LoRA 的冻结主干模型会生成一条推理轨迹，随后输出一个结构化动作。 该框架执行该动作，并且对于非终结动作，会将反馈和更新后的状态快照附加到对话中。 随后，策略基于这一扩展后的上下文继续处理，同时保留其先前的推理、动作和观察结果。 在最终答案解码时，该框架会禁用策略 LoRA，并根据动作序列的指定，使用不带适配器的冻结主干模型，或使用选定的技能 LoRA。 答案生成上下文仅包含原始查询；它不包含策略推理、动作历史和环境观察结果。 最终生成的响应将作为最终答案提交，从而结束该查询的交互。

paragraphs.en: Each policy turn emits one structured action following its reasoning trace. Table 6 summarizes the action arguments, execution effects, and preconditions. Only Generate terminates the interaction; the other actions return observations that inform the policy’s next decision. Each query allows at most six policy turns and one successful adaptation. Parsing errors, unmet preconditions, and recoverable execution failures are reported through observations, allowing the policy to revise its action. Every policy turn consumes the turn budget, including rejected actions and policy-issued retries, whereas a rejected Adapt does not consume the adaptation allowance. If the turn budget is exhausted before the policy submits an answer, the harness forces direct answer generation with the frozen backbone and no skill adapter.
paragraphs.zh: 每个策略回合都会根据其推理轨迹发出一个结构化动作。 表 6 总结了动作参数、执行效果及前提条件。 只有“生成”操作会终止交互；其他动作则会返回观察结果，为策略的下一步决策提供信息。 每次查询最多允许六个策略回合和一次成功适配。 解析错误、未满足的前提条件以及可恢复的执行失败会通过观察结果报告，从而让策略能够修正其动作。 每个策略回合都会消耗回合预算，包括被拒绝的动作和策略发起的重试；而被拒绝的“适配”操作则不会消耗适配配额。 如果策略在提交答案前用尽了回合预算，系统框架将强制使用冻结的主干架构且无需技能适配器来直接生成答案。

paragraphs.en: The policy decides whether to archive the current query based on its content, the relevance of the visible pools, and the material available for adaptation. To perform Assign , it specifies a pool name and a structured payload. The harness constructs pool names from a query-type prefix and a descriptor or identifier derived from the input. For example, mcq-medical-4opt encodes the multiple-choice format, a rule-derived domain label, and the number of options, The resulting name is shown to the policy and validated when processing Assign .

paragraphs.en: Each pool retains its archived samples and at most one current skill adapter. The first successful Adapt creates this adapter. For incremental re-adaptation, the harness warm-starts from the existing adapter and trains on newly accumulated samples together with up to eight randomly selected replay samples. The updated adapter replaces its predecessor, while the archived samples remain in the pool. Pools and stored adapters persist across queries. Each visible pool entry shows its name, material excerpts, total and unconsumed sample counts, and training state, along with the adapter ID and TTT method when available. paragraphs.en: In this section, we discuss the limitations of this work and highlight opportunities for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将讨论本研究的局限性，并指出未来研究的机会。

paragraphs.en: Our benchmark deliberately enriches queries with observed TTT benefits to evaluate how effectively the proposed pipeline can train a policy to exploit adaptation opportunities. This outcome-based selection limits the generality of the reported gains. On workloads where beneficial adaptation is rare or yields only modest improvements, the achievable aggregate gains may be substantially smaller, and the performance gap over competing baselines may narrow or disappear. Our results therefore do not establish a consistent advantage across arbitrary deployment distributions. The potential benefit of TTT agency is constrained by the available TTT methods, their suitability for the target workload, the backbone’s remaining improvement headroom, and the computation budget. Policy learning can help realize this potential through appropriate adaptation and reuse decisions, but cannot guarantee gains where no TTT method can provide useful improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基准测试特意通过加入已观察到的 TTT 收益来丰富查询，以评估所提出的流程能多有效地训练策略，从而利用适应机会。 这种基于结果的筛选方式限制了所报告收益的普遍性。 在有益适应罕见或仅带来轻微改进的工作负载中，可实现的总体收益可能显著更小，与竞争基线模型之间的性能差距也可能缩小甚至消失。 因此，我们的结果并未证明该方法在任何部署分布下都具有持续的优势。 TTT 智能体的潜在收益受到可用 TTT 方法、这些方法对目标工作负载的适用性、主干模型剩余的改进空间以及计算预算的限制。 策略学习可以通过适当的适应和重用决策来帮助实现这一潜力，但在没有 TTT 方法能够提供有效改进的情况下，它无法保证产生收益。

paragraphs.en: Our RL stage optimizes query-level returns, while the training stream advances through annotated gold actions. Equation equation 4 therefore specifies the deployment objective, which is not directly optimized over complete streams during training. Sample accumulation and skill construction for future reuse are primarily supported by the priors established through heuristic-guided SFT, while RL refines decisions using current-query outcomes. Although RL rollouts are sampled from the policy, their initial library and pool states are generated by gold action histories. This creates a mismatch with autonomous deployment, where earlier policy decisions determine subsequent states, and can introduce exposure bias. Learning across queries requires addressing delayed credit assignment: the benefit of collecting material or constructing a skill may emerge much later, and a single successful answer may depend on several earlier decisions. Attributing such benefits to the contributing actions is a central challenge. We leave training on autonomous streams with explicit cross-query credit assignment to future work. Such training could improve both long-term utility and robustness to states arising from the policy’s own decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的强化学习阶段优化查询级别的回报，而训练流程则通过标注的黄金动作逐步推进。 因此，方程 4 明确了部署目标，该目标在训练期间不会直接针对完整的流程进行优化。 样本积累和未来可重用的技能构建主要由通过启发式引导的 SFT 建立的先验知识支持，而强化学习则利用当前查询的结果来优化决策。 尽管强化学习的展开是从策略中采样的，但其初始库和池状态是由黄金动作历史生成的。 这与自主部署存在不匹配：在自主部署中，早期的策略决策会决定后续状态，并可能引入暴露偏差。 跨查询的学习需要解决延迟信用分配问题：收集材料或构建技能的收益可能在很久之后才显现，而单个成功的答案可能依赖于多个早期的决策。 将此类收益归因于有贡献的动作是一项核心挑战。 我们将带有明确跨查询信用分配的自主流程训练留待未来工作处理。 此类训练能够提升长期效用，并增强对策略自身决策所产生状态的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: TTRL’s model-generated pseudo-labels may reinforce incorrect predictions, and a shared skill library may propagate errors or become a target for poisoning through adaptation material. Our design provides a degree of containment: each skill is an isolated LoRA adapter, and the pretrained backbone remains frozen. A harmful skill can therefore be disabled or removed independently, without reverting the backbone or unrelated adapters. Compared with continual full-parameter updates, this separation makes harmful parameter changes easier to isolate and roll back. However, reversibility does not prevent harmful outputs while a compromised skill is active or undo their downstream consequences. Detecting poisoned skills and assessing robustness under adversarial adaptation remain important directions for future work.
paragraphs.zh: TTRL 模型生成的伪标签可能会强化错误预测，而共享的技能库则可能通过适配材料传播错误或成为投毒的目标。 我们的设计提供了一定程度的隔离：每个技能都是一个独立的 LoRA 适配器，且预训练的骨干网络保持冻结状态。 因此，有害技能可以被独立禁用或移除，而无需回退骨干网络或无关的适配器。 与持续的全参数更新相比，这种分离使得有害的参数变更更容易被隔离和回滚。 然而，可逆性并不能在受影响的技能处于激活状态时阻止有害输出，也无法消除其下游后果。 检测被投毒的技能并评估其在对抗性适配下的鲁棒性，仍然是未来研究的重要方向。
